posts.preview: Information at my disposal indicates that Namibia’s retail and wholesale industries are approximately 75% dominated by foreign investors

I would like to believe that when Namibians do business in other countries, they are expected to comply with the laws and regulations of those countries. Therefore, non-compliance should result in compliance orders and enforcement measures, rather than merely education orders

Labour laws are put in place for a reason: to protect workers, promote fair employment practices, and support the government’s efforts to reduce poverty and improve the livelihoods of people in society
Compliance with labour laws should therefore be treated as a serious obligation, regardless of whether a business is locally or foreign-owned
